verdict.rationale: The only free path the evidence shows is Glama's hosted MCP Inspector, which needs no login and lets you test tools against any remote MCP server, which covers browser-based prototyping of tool connections. No free tier or plan limits are documented, and a community report says a credit card was needed for hosted rebuild/release, which suggests hosting and Gateway use may not be free. missing for 10: documented free-tier plan and quotas, free hosted deployment and Gateway usage for prototyping, independent confirmation of what is usable without payment.

support.subject: As a developer, I can prototype my agent's tool connections on a meaningful free tier before paying anything

citations.quote: Inspect any MCP server directly from your browser. No login required.
Glama's hosted inspector connects to remote Streamable HTTP and SSE endpoints so you can inspect available capabilities and test requests interactively
Turned out a credit card was required for rebuild/release to work, which wasn't documented
